description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:589-595 — The debug_assert! in LintRunner::new detects duplicate lint IDs by sorting a Vec of IDs and then checking windows(2). The idiomatic approach is: ids.sort_unstable(); ids.dedup(); ids.len() == lints.len(). The windows(2) pattern is less obvious and requires the reader to reconstruct that w[0] != w[1] for all adjacent pairs is equivalent to all-unique after sorting. Minor readability issue only.
title: LintRunner::new dedup check uses sort+windows instead of dedup
